		}
		if (ctx.setTransform) {
		    assert.strictEqual(ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0), undefined, "ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0)", "undefined")
		    assert.strictEqual(ctx.setTransform(), undefined, "ctx.setTransform()", "undefined")
		}
		assert.strictEqual(ctx.clearRect(0, 0, 0, 0), undefined, "ctx.clearRect(0, 0, 0, 0)", "undefined")
		assert.strictEqual(ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 0, 0), undefined, "ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 0, 0)", "undefined")
		assert.strictEqual(ctx.strokeRect(0, 0, 0, 0), undefined, "ctx.strokeRect(0, 0, 0, 0)", "undefined")
		assert.strictEqual(ctx.beginPath(), undefined, "ctx.beginPath()", "undefined")
		assert.strictEqual(ctx.closePath(), undefined, "ctx.closePath()", "undefined")
		assert.strictEqual(ctx.moveTo(0, 0), undefined, "ctx.moveTo(0, 0)", "undefined")
		assert.strictEqual(ctx.lineTo(0, 0), undefined, "ctx.lineTo(0, 0)", "undefined")
		assert.strictEqual(ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, 0, 0, 0), undefined, "ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, 0, 0, 0)", "undefined")
		assert.strictEqual(ctx.bezierCurveTo(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0), undefined, "ctx.bezierCurveTo(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)", "undefined")
		assert.strictEqual(ctx.arcTo(0, 0, 0, 0, 1), undefined, "ctx.arcTo(0, 0, 0, 0, 1)", "undefined")
		assert.strictEqual(ctx.rect(0, 0, 0, 0), undefined, "ctx.rect(0, 0, 0, 0)", "undefined")
		assert.strictEqual(ctx.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, 0, true), undefined, "ctx.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, 0, true)", "undefined")
		assert.strictEqual(ctx.fill(), undefined, "ctx.fill()", "undefined")
		assert.strictEqual(ctx.stroke(), undefined, "ctx.stroke()", "undefined")
		assert.strictEqual(ctx.clip(), undefined, "ctx.clip()", "undefined")
		if (ctx.fillText) {

		    assert.strictEqual(ctx.strokeText('test', 0, 0), undefined, "ctx.strokeText('test', 0, 0)", "undefined")
		}
